connector.name: MERX - TRON Resource Exchange
connector.registryDescription: TRON energy exchange for AI agents. 54 tools, 30 prompts, 21 resources. A2A + ACP.
connector.summary: Hosted at merx.exchange over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package merx-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace exchange.merx. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MERX_API_KEY
env.description: API key from merx.exchange. Unlocks trading, balance, standing orders, and monitors.

env.name: TRON_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: TRON wallet private key for signing transactions. Never sent to any server. Enables transfers, swaps, and contract calls.
